title.en: IELTS Reading: One paragraph, one main idea
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Bitta xatboshi — bitta asosiy fikr
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Один абзац — одна главная мысль

body.en:
In Matching headings you get a list of headings and choose one for each paragraph. A heading names the main idea of the whole paragraph, not one fact in it.
1. Read the paragraph. The first and the last sentences often carry the main idea.
2. Say its point in a few words of your own, for example "why the market moved".
3. Find the heading that says the same thing in other words.
4. The list has more headings than there are paragraphs, so some headings are never used.
Check: does the heading fit every sentence? If it fits only one sentence, it names a detail, not the main idea.
body.uz:
Matching headings (sarlavha tanlash) topshirigʻida sizga sarlavhalar roʻyxati beriladi va har bir xatboshiga bittasini tanlaysiz. Sarlavha butun xatboshining asosiy fikrini aytadi, undagi bitta faktni emas.
1. Xatboshini oʻqing. Asosiy fikr koʻpincha birinchi va oxirgi gapda boʻladi.
2. Fikrni oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan qisqa ayting, masalan: «bozor nega koʻchdi».
3. Xuddi shu fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytgan sarlavhani toping.
4. Roʻyxatda sarlavhalar xatboshilardan koʻp, shuning uchun baʼzilari umuman ishlatilmaydi.
Tekshiring: sarlavha har bir gapga mos keladimi? Faqat bitta gapga mos kelsa, u tafsilotni aytadi, asosiy fikrni emas.
body.ru:
В задании Matching headings (подбор заголовков) дан список заголовков, и к каждому абзацу нужно выбрать один. Заголовок называет главную мысль всего абзаца, а не один факт из него.
1. Прочитайте абзац. Главная мысль часто в первом и последнем предложениях.
2. Сформулируйте суть коротко, своими словами, например: «почему рынок переехал».
3. Найдите заголовок, который передаёт то же самое другими словами.
4. Заголовков больше, чем абзацев, поэтому некоторые останутся лишними.
Проверка: подходит ли заголовок к каждому предложению? Если только к одному, это деталь, а не главная мысль.

body.en:
Paragraph: "Most visitors to Lake Orra come for the boat trips, but few know that the lake is also a classroom. Every week, pupils from nearby villages measure the water, count the birds on the shore and write down what they see. Their notes go to the regional water office."
Step 1. Sum it up: pupils use the lake for science work.
Step 2. Test each heading.
• "Boat trips on Lake Orra": half of the first sentence. A detail.
• "Birds of the lake shore": one task of three. A detail.
• "A lake that is also a school": fits every sentence. ✔
Now you: read the paragraph in the question. Sum it up in a few words, then choose its heading.
body.uz:
Xatboshi: «Most visitors to Lake Orra come for the boat trips, but few know that the lake is also a classroom. Every week, pupils from nearby villages measure the water, count the birds on the shore and write down what they see. Their notes go to the regional water office.»
1-qadam. Qisqa xulosa: oʻquvchilar koʻldan ilmiy ish uchun foydalanadi.
2-qadam. Har bir sarlavhani sinab koʻring.
• «Boat trips on Lake Orra»: birinchi gapning yarmi. Tafsilot.
• «Birds of the lake shore»: uchta ishdan bittasi. Tafsilot.
• «A lake that is also a school»: har bir gapga mos. ✔
Endi siz: savoldagi xatboshini oʻqing. Uni bir necha soʻz bilan xulosa qiling, keyin sarlavhasini tanlang.
body.ru:
Абзац: «Most visitors to Lake Orra come for the boat trips, but few know that the lake is also a classroom. Every week, pupils from nearby villages measure the water, count the birds on the shore and write down what they see. Their notes go to the regional water office.»
Шаг 1. Суть: школьники используют озеро для научной работы.
Шаг 2. Проверьте каждый заголовок.
• «Boat trips on Lake Orra»: половина первого предложения. Деталь.
• «Birds of the lake shore»: одно занятие из трёх. Деталь.
• «A lake that is also a school»: подходит к каждому предложению. ✔
Теперь попробуйте сами: прочитайте абзац в вопросе, сформулируйте его суть в нескольких словах и выберите заголовок.

body.en:
Watch out: the same word is not the same idea.
A wrong heading often repeats a word that stands out in the paragraph: a number, a name, an unusual word. It catches your eye, so it feels right. But matching words is not matching ideas.
Example: a paragraph about a village that lived without electricity for a week after a storm says "storm" once, in its first line. The heading "How storms begin" shares the word, but the paragraph is about life without power.
Also watch for a heading that fits only half of the paragraph.
Choose by the idea, then check that every sentence fits.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: bir xil soʻz — bir xil fikr degani emas.
Notoʻgʻri sarlavha koʻpincha xatboshidagi koʻzga tashlanadigan soʻzni takrorlaydi: son, ism yoki gʻalati soʻz. U eʼtiborni tortadi va toʻgʻridek tuyuladi. Lekin soʻzlarning mosligi fikrning mosligi emas.
Misol: boʻrondan keyin bir hafta elektrsiz yashagan qishloq haqidagi xatboshida «storm» soʻzi faqat birinchi qatorda bir marta keladi. «How storms begin» sarlavhasida ham shu soʻz bor, lekin xatboshi elektrsiz hayot haqida.
Faqat xatboshining yarmiga mos keladigan sarlavhadan ham ehtiyot boʻling.
Fikrga qarab tanlang, keyin har bir gap mos kelishini tekshiring.
body.ru:
Осторожно: то же слово — ещё не та же мысль.
Неверный заголовок часто повторяет заметное слово из абзаца: число, имя, необычное слово. Оно бросается в глаза и кажется верным. Но совпадение слов — не совпадение мысли.
Пример: в абзаце о деревне, которая неделю жила без электричества после бури, слово «storm» стоит один раз, в первой строке. В заголовке «How storms begin» то же слово, но абзац — о жизни без света.
Осторожно и с заголовком, который подходит только к половине абзаца.
Выбирайте по мысли, затем проверьте, что заголовок подходит к каждому предложению.

title.en: IELTS Reading: Words from the text, within the word limit
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Matndagi soʻzlar bilan, soʻz chegarasidan oshmasdan
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Слова из текста, в пределах лимита слов

body.en:
In sentence completion and summary completion, you fill a gap with words taken from the text.
1. Read the word limit in the instructions, for example NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS, and keep within it.
2. Read the sentence and guess what kind of word is missing: a thing, a number, a describing word?
3. Find the right place in the text. The sentence usually says the idea in other words, so look for a synonym, not only the same word.
4. Copy the words exactly as the text spells them.
Last, read the finished sentence: it must make sense and be correct English.
body.uz:
Sentence completion (gapni toʻldirish) va summary completion (qisqa bayonni toʻldirish) topshiriqlarida boʻsh joyni matndan olingan soʻzlar bilan toʻldirasiz.
1. Koʻrsatmadagi soʻz chegarasini oʻqing, masalan NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS (ikki soʻzdan oshmasin), va undan oshmang.
2. Gapni oʻqing va qanday soʻz yetishmayotganini taxmin qiling: narsami, sonmi, sifatmi?
3. Matndan kerakli joyni toping. Gap odatda fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi, shuning uchun faqat aynan shu soʻzni emas, sinonimini ham qidiring.
4. Soʻzlarni matnda qanday yozilgan boʻlsa, xuddi shunday koʻchiring.
Oxirida tayyor gapni oʻqing: u maʼnoli va toʻgʻri ingliz tilida boʻlishi kerak.
body.ru:
В заданиях sentence completion (дополнить предложение) и summary completion (дополнить краткое изложение) пропуск заполняют словами из текста.
1. Посмотрите, какой лимит слов указан в инструкции, например NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS (не больше двух слов), и не превышайте его.
2. Прочитайте предложение и угадайте, какое слово пропущено: предмет, число, признак?
3. Найдите нужное место в тексте. Предложение обычно передаёт ту же мысль другими словами, поэтому ищите синоним, а не только то же слово.
4. Перепишите слова точно так, как они написаны в тексте.
В конце прочитайте готовое предложение: оно должно иметь смысл и быть грамматически правильным по-английски.

body.en:
Text: "Visitors to the Ashgrove caves must book a tour in advance. Each tour lasts ninety minutes and is led by a guide, who carries the only lamp. Visitors are given helmets at the entrance."
Sentence: Visitors receive ______ before they go into the caves. (ONE WORD ONLY)
Step 1. The limit is one word.
Step 2. After "receive" comes a thing, probably plural.
Step 3. "receive" = "are given"; "before they go into the caves" = "at the entrance".
Step 4. Copy it: helmets. Not "lamp": the guide carries it.
Now you: in the question, find the place in the text that the sentence describes, then copy the words.
body.uz:
Matn: «Visitors to the Ashgrove caves must book a tour in advance. Each tour lasts ninety minutes and is led by a guide, who carries the only lamp. Visitors are given helmets at the entrance.»
Gap: Visitors receive ______ before they go into the caves. (ONE WORD ONLY — faqat bitta soʻz)
1-qadam. Chegara — bitta soʻz.
2-qadam. «receive» dan keyin narsa keladi, ehtimol koʻplikda.
3-qadam. «receive» = «are given»; «before they go into the caves» = «at the entrance».
4-qadam. Koʻchiring: helmets. «lamp» emas: uni gid olib yuradi.
Endi siz: savolda gap tasvirlagan joyni matndan toping, keyin soʻzlarni koʻchiring.
body.ru:
Текст: «Visitors to the Ashgrove caves must book a tour in advance. Each tour lasts ninety minutes and is led by a guide, who carries the only lamp. Visitors are given helmets at the entrance.»
Предложение: Visitors receive ______ before they go into the caves. (ONE WORD ONLY — только одно слово)
Шаг 1. Лимит — одно слово.
Шаг 2. После «receive» идёт предмет, скорее всего во множественном числе.
Шаг 3. «receive» = «are given»; «before they go into the caves» = «at the entrance».
Шаг 4. Переписываем: helmets. Не «lamp»: её несёт гид.
Теперь попробуйте сами: в вопросе найдите место в тексте, о котором говорит предложение, и перепишите слова.

body.en:
Watch out: two traps in completion.
Trap 1: too many words. If the limit is NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS, "the old stone bridge" is wrong, even though every word is in the text. Keep the words that carry the meaning: "stone bridge".
Trap 2: your own word. A word that means the same but is not in the text is marked wrong. If the text says "lorries", do not write "trucks".
Also check the grammar: the finished sentence must read correctly, with a plural where the sentence needs one.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: toʻldirishda ikkita tuzoq bor.
1-tuzoq: soʻz juda koʻp. Chegara NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS boʻlsa, «the old stone bridge» notoʻgʻri, garchi har bir soʻz matnda boʻlsa ham. Maʼnoni beradigan soʻzlarni qoldiring: «stone bridge».
2-tuzoq: oʻzingizning soʻzingiz. Maʼnosi bir xil, lekin matnda yoʻq soʻz notoʻgʻri hisoblanadi. Matnda «lorries» boʻlsa, «trucks» deb yozmang.
Grammatikani ham tekshiring: tayyor gap grammatik jihatdan toʻgʻri boʻlishi kerak, zarur joyda koʻplik shakli bilan.
body.ru:
Осторожно: в заданиях на заполнение пропусков две ловушки.
Ловушка 1: слишком много слов. Если лимит NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS, ответ «the old stone bridge» неверен, хотя все слова есть в тексте. Оставьте слова, которые несут смысл: «stone bridge».
Ловушка 2: своё слово. Слово с тем же значением, которого нет в тексте, засчитывается как ошибка. Если в тексте «lorries», не пишите «trucks».
Проверьте и грамматику: готовое предложение должно читаться правильно, со множественным числом там, где оно нужно.

stem.en:
For years, the Saturday market in Pellworth filled the narrow square beside the church. Stallholders arrived before dawn and still could not find space, shoppers queued just to walk between the stalls, and delivery vans blocked the streets all around. Last spring the town council moved the market to the old bus station, which is three times larger and has its own car park. Traders now have room for twice as many stalls.

Choose the best heading for this paragraph.

options.en: Why the market moved to a larger site
The history of the church square
How traders set up their stalls before dawn
Problems with the new car park

why.en: "Why the market moved to a larger site": every sentence is about the crowded square and the move. The church and the dawn start are details.
why.uz: «Why the market moved to a larger site»: har bir gap tor maydon va koʻchish haqida. Cherkov va tongdagi tayyorgarlik — tafsilotlar.
why.ru: «Why the market moved to a larger site»: все предложения — о тесной площади и переезде. Церковь и торговцы, которые приезжают до рассвета, — детали.

instructions.en: Choose the best heading for the paragraph.
instructions.uz: Xatboshi uchun eng mos sarlavhani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите наиболее подходящий заголовок для абзаца.

stem.en:
At the Kettleby bakery, nothing is thrown away. Bread that is not sold by six o'clock goes to a night shelter the same evening. Stale loaves are dried, ground and sold back to customers as breadcrumbs. Even the empty flour sacks are washed and sewn into shopping bags, which the bakery gives away free. The owner says the idea came from her grandmother, who never wasted a crumb.

Choose the best heading for this paragraph.

options.en: Helping people at a night shelter
Shopping bags made from flour sacks
How to dry and grind old bread

why.en: "A bakery that wastes nothing": the first sentence says it, and each sentence after it is an example. The shelter and the bags are single examples.
why.uz: «A bakery that wastes nothing»: birinchi gap shuni aytadi, keyingi har bir gap — misol. Boshpana va sumkalar — alohida misollar.
why.ru: «A bakery that wastes nothing»: это сказано в первом предложении, а дальше идут примеры. Приют и сумки — отдельные примеры.

instructions.en: Choose the best heading for the paragraph.
instructions.uz: Xatboshi uchun eng mos sarlavhani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите наиболее подходящий заголовок для абзаца.

stem.en:
The library in Marrowgate holds 40,000 books, but last year its busiest spot was a single table by the door. Every Thursday evening, retired engineers sit there with children and help them repair broken toys, radios and bicycle lights. Parents say their children learn more about how things work in one evening than in a month of lessons. The table is now booked weeks ahead.

Choose the best heading for this paragraph.

options.en: How to book a library table

why.en: "Learning by repairing things" fits every sentence: the children learn by fixing things with engineers. "40,000 books" repeats a number from the text, but it is only the opening detail.
why.uz: «Learning by repairing things» har bir gapga mos: bolalar muhandislar bilan narsalarni taʼmirlab oʻrganadi. «40,000 books» matndagi sonni takrorlaydi, lekin u faqat boshidagi tafsilot.
why.ru: «Learning by repairing things» подходит ко всем предложениям: дети учатся, чиня вещи вместе с инженерами. «40,000 books» повторяет число из текста, но это лишь деталь из начала абзаца.

instructions.en: Choose the best heading for the paragraph.
instructions.uz: Xatboshi uchun eng mos sarlavhani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите наиболее подходящий заголовок для абзаца.

stem.en:
The Tollan Valley railway closes every winter, when snow blocks the line above the village of Brannock. During those months, a bus carries passengers between the two ends of the line instead. In spring, before the trains run again, a team of workers walks the whole track to check the rails and clear away fallen rocks. The first train of the year is always full.

Complete the sentence. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

Before the line opens again, workers check the rails and remove ______.

why.en: "fallen rocks": workers "clear away fallen rocks". "large fallen rocks" is three words and adds "large", which is not in the text.
why.uz: «fallen rocks»: ishchilar «clear away fallen rocks». «large fallen rocks» — uch soʻz, «large» esa matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: «fallen rocks»: рабочие «clear away fallen rocks». «large fallen rocks» — три слова, и «large» в тексте нет.

instructions.en: Complete the sentence with words from the text. Keep to the word limit.
instructions.uz: Gapni matndagi soʻzlar bilan toʻldiring. Belgilangan soʻz sonidan oshmang.
instructions.ru: Дополните предложение словами из текста. Не превышайте лимит слов.

stem.en:
At the Merrow Hill observatory, public evenings are held every Friday from October to March. Visitors look through the main telescope only when the sky is clear; on cloudy nights, an astronomer gives a talk in the lecture room instead. Warm clothes are recommended, as the dome where the telescope stands is not heated. Children under ten must come with an adult.

Complete the sentence. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

Visitors are advised to bring ______.

why.en: "warm clothes": "advised" says "recommended" in other words, and "Warm clothes are recommended". "heated clothes" is not in the text.
why.uz: «warm clothes»: «advised» — «recommended» ning boshqacha aytilishi; matnda «Warm clothes are recommended». «heated clothes» matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: «warm clothes»: «advised» — другими словами «recommended», а в тексте «Warm clothes are recommended». «heated clothes» в тексте нет.

instructions.en: Complete the sentence with words from the text. Keep to the word limit.
instructions.uz: Gapni matndagi soʻzlar bilan toʻldiring. Belgilangan soʻz sonidan oshmang.
instructions.ru: Дополните предложение словами из текста. Не превышайте лимит слов.

stem.en:
Every autumn the people of Fenwick hold a lantern walk through the old town. Children make their lanterns at school from paper and thin willow sticks. On the night of the walk, volunteers hand out small battery lights to put inside the lanterns, because real candles are no longer allowed in the narrow streets. The walk ends with music in the market square.

Complete the sentence. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

The children's lanterns are made of paper and ______.

why.en: "willow sticks": the lanterns are made "from paper and thin willow sticks". "thin willow sticks" is three words; "wooden" is not in the text.
why.uz: «willow sticks»: fonarlar «from paper and thin willow sticks» yasaladi. «thin willow sticks» — uch soʻz; «wooden» matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: «willow sticks»: фонарики делают «from paper and thin willow sticks». «thin willow sticks» — три слова; «wooden» в тексте нет.

instructions.en: Complete the sentence with words from the text. Keep to the word limit.
instructions.uz: Gapni matndagi soʻzlar bilan toʻldiring. Belgilangan soʻz sonidan oshmang.
instructions.ru: Дополните предложение словами из текста. Не превышайте лимит слов.
